purpose: A separate implementation tests the previously published classical bulk predictions. This is an author numerical test, not an empirical or blinded test.
preparation: Full real u,w,S fields and momenta. Initial velocities rotate the charged field once; no background or frequency is held fixed during evolution. A cosine perturbs either the charged amplitude or S.

analysis.frequency_extraction: Find the two largest separated nonzero Fourier peaks of the charged-amplitude mode (one peak for S seed), then fit sinusoidal frequencies by variable projection. Theory values are not used as fit starting values.
analysis.scope: Plane-dependent uniform bulk tests. No finite-droplet or nonlinear unrestricted-3D verdict. Conservation checks are sampled. Frequency fits use a theory-informed number of branches, not a theory-fixed frequency.
